admin.menu.title: Google SSO Extended
admin.header.title: Google SSO Extended
admin.header.description: Secure OAuth 2.0 authentication with primary CTA placement and authentic Google Identity styling.
admin.redirect.title: Authorized Redirect URI
admin.redirect.lead: Copy this exact callback URL into your Google Cloud Console credentials page under Authorised redirect URIs.
admin.guide.title: Step-by-Step Google Cloud Console Setup Guide
admin.guide.step1: Visit the Google Cloud Credentials Console and create or select a project.
admin.guide.step2: Configure the OAuth consent screen with your forum app name and contact email.
admin.guide.step3: Navigate to Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth Client ID.
admin.guide.step4: Select Web application as the Application type.
admin.guide.step5: Paste the URL above into Authorised redirect URIs and hit Enter.
admin.guide.step6: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret into the form below, save, and restart NodeBB.
admin.credentials.title: API Credentials & Security
admin.credentials.client_id_help: Obtained from the Google Cloud Console Credentials page.
admin.credentials.client_secret_help: Your client secret is stored securely and never transmitted to client browsers.
admin.layout.title: Layout, UX & Button Placement
admin.layout.lead: Customize the appearance, prominence, and positioning of Google Sign-in across your forum.
admin.layout.placement_help: Selecting Top of Form embeds the Google sign-in button above email & password fields with an 'or' divider.
admin.layout.label: Button Text
admin.layout.preview_tip: Live Preview: Changes to placement, style, and button text reflect immediately in the Live Button Preview on the right.
admin.layout.hide_alt: Clean up Desktop Layout: Hide orphaned 'Alternative Logins' header when Google is primary
admin.layout.hide_alt_help: Removes the redundant right-hand column on desktop, cleanly centering the login card.
admin.layout.apply_register: Apply primary Google CTA placement on Registration page (/register)
admin.policies.title: Registration & Verification Policies
admin.policies.autoconfirm_help: Skip forum email activation since Google has already verified the account owner's email address.
admin.policies.disable_registration: Disable new user registrations via Google SSO
admin.policies.disable_registration_help: Only permits existing registered forum members to link and authenticate with their Google account.
